event.title: Guinea-Bissau Holds Referendum to Enhance Presidential Powers Amid Controversy
event.canonical_title: Guinea-Bissau Holds Referendum to Enhance Presidential Powers Amid Controversy
event.summary: Voters in Guinea-Bissau participated in a referendum to amend the constitution, aiming to increase presidential powers. The military government, which took control last year, is proposing changes that would allow the president to appoint and dismiss the prime minister. This vote precedes planned elections in December to restore civilian rule.

timeline.title: Counting Begins in Guinea-Bissau Referendum on Presidential Power Expansion
timeline.summary: Vote counting has commenced in Guinea-Bissau following a referendum that could expand presidential powers. The proposed constitutional amendments include provisions that would allow the president to appoint and dismiss the prime minister. This referendum is part of a broader process aimed at restoring civilian rule after a military coup.
key_facts: Referendum held to vote on expanding presidential powers.
Proposed changes include the right for the president to appoint and dismiss the prime minister.
The referendum follows a military coup and is part of efforts to restore civilian governance.
